description: Builds computed signing field formulas from numeric field tokens and operators.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: All fields in the current signing template.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve field labels in the token picker.

parameters.name: CurrentFieldUuid
parameters.description: Field identifier edited by the formula builder when <see cref="Field"/> is not supplied.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether the builder controls are disabled.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when a field label is missing for <see cref="Culture"/>.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Computed field edited by the formula builder.

parameters.name: FieldChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked after the edited field is updated on save.

parameters.name: Saved
parameters.description: Callback invoked after a valid formula is saved. The supplied value is normalized to UUID tokens.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Field identifier edited by the formula builder when is not supplied.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when displayed formula text changes.
